verdict.rationale: telli offers a real-time Live Monitoring call overview (telli-docs-32) and webhooks that push real-time notifications on call events/status/outcomes (telli-docs-13, telli-docs-21), which a platform engineer could wire into an alerting pipeline, plus metric tracking like success/reach rate (telli-docs-7). However there is no documented built-in alerting mechanism, error-rate-spike detection, or agent-misbehavior alerting system. Missing for 10: native alert/notification thresholds, anomaly or error-rate-spike detection, and evidence of alert delivery (email/Slack/PagerDuty) tied to live monitoring.
